post.description: Create a project-level snapshot for either project status or ad hoc type. This is rate limited to one request per hour for each project and budget view, regardless of snapshot type.

budget_template_id.description: The budget template identifier (deprecated, use budget_view_id instead)

name.description: Title of the budget view snapshot

description.example: This is the budget snapshot for the new year

snapshot_type.description: Snapshot Type. Only available when Project Status Snapshots feature is enabled.

status_id.description:
The ID of a custom status.
Only available when the Custom Statuses feature is enabled. When enabled, use this
parameter instead of approval_status. The status_id must reference an available
custom status configured for the company.

date_range_for_actuals.description:
Filters actuals data to a specific date range when generating the snapshot.
Provide exactly two dates in ISO 8601 format representing the start and end of the range.

only_actuals_with_dates.description:
When true, only actuals records with a date within date_range_for_actuals are included.
When false (default), actuals records with no date are also included alongside date-ranged results.

financial_period_id.description:
The ID of the Financial Period to associate with this snapshot.
Only available when the Financial Periods feature is enabled.

reassign_financial_period.description:
Only applies when snapshot_type is project_status_snapshot and financial_period_id is provided.
When true, if the requested financial_period_id is already assigned to another snapshot in the
same project and budget view, that snapshot is converted to ad_hoc and its period released so
this snapshot can take it. When false or omitted, the request is rejected if the period is
already in use.

import http.client

x-changelog.summary: Introducing v1.0 Budget View Snapshot create endpoint
x-changelog.description:
Introduction of Public API endpoint for creating a Budget Snapshot.
This endpoint was introduced with the rate limit of 1 request per project per budget per hour.

x-changelog.summary: Extend v1.0 Budget View Snapshot create endpoint
x-changelog.description:
Introduction of Budget Snapshot asynchronous creation. This is limited to 1 request per project per budget per hour.
When the asynchronous snapshot feature is enabled, a 202 response is returned, indicating that the system will process the requests asynchronously. For those with the feature disabled, the success response will be 201.

x-changelog.summary: Add v1.0 Budget View Snapshot parameter budget_view_id
x-changelog.description: Create Budget View Snapshot using the budget_view_id parameter instead of budget_template_id.
Add the ability to create Budget View Snapshots with snapshot_type and approval_status parameters when the Project Status Snapshots feature is enabled.

x-changelog.summary: Add status_id parameter for Custom Statuses
x-changelog.description: Add the ability to create Budget View Snapshots with `status_id` parameter.

x-changelog.summary: Add actuals date range filter parameters
x-changelog.description:
Add `date_range_for_actuals` and `only_actuals_with_dates` parameters to the create endpoint.
`date_range_for_actuals` accepts an array of two ISO 8601 dates (start and end) to scope actuals data to a specific date window.
`only_actuals_with_dates` is a boolean that controls whether actuals records with no date are excluded when date filtering is applied.

x-changelog.summary: Accept Project Status Snapshot attributes without project LD flag
x-changelog.description:
Create requests accept `snapshot_type`, `approval_status`, and related parameters whenever valid for the company,
without a separate project-level LaunchDarkly gate for Project Status Snapshots.

x-changelog.summary: Add financial_period_id parameter to create endpoint
x-changelog.description:
Add the ability to associate a Budget View Snapshot with a Financial Period
by providing the `financial_period_id` parameter on create.
Only available when the Financial Periods feature is enabled.

x-changelog.summary: Add reassign_financial_period parameter to create endpoint
x-changelog.description:
Add the `reassign_financial_period` parameter on create. When true and the snapshot is a
project_status_snapshot, if the requested `financial_period_id` is already assigned to another
snapshot in the same project and budget view, that snapshot is converted to ad_hoc and its period
released so the new snapshot can take it, instead of the request being rejected.
